integrity: Proof and independent exact finite-state checker supplied; finite checks are not substitutes for the asymptotic proof.
scientific_limitations: Exact growth-root law is for unweighted K_{2,b} with root in two-vertex part; asymptotics as b increases. General K_{a,b} and other roots not addressed. Absolute priority and independent audit unverified.
title: A Rayleigh–Gaussian root-degree law for frontier-grown bipartite trees
